summary.name: Kimi API Platform
summary.one_liner: Quickstart docs for the Kimi API, covering how to get an API key, choose a model (Kimi K3.1 Pro or its high-speed variant), and make a first call via OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible formats.
use_cases: Calling Kimi models from Python or Node.js code
Integrating Kimi into an app using the OpenAI SDK
Using Kimi with the Anthropic SDK or Claude Code
Testing prompts in a no-code playground
summary.what_it_does: The page is a quickstart guide for the Kimi API. It walks through creating and storing an API key in an environment variable (MOONSHOT_API_KEY), picking a model such as kimi-k3.1-pro or kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed, and choosing an integration method: Chat Completions, Responses, or Messages API, with a Playground for testing without code. It lists prerequisites (Python 3.9+ or Node.js 18+, OpenAI SDK 1.0.0+) and examples in Python, curl, and Node.js. It also points to pages on streaming, multi-turn chat, multimodal input, tool calls, JSON mode, and thinking models. The K3.1 Pro model has a 1M-token context window and a reasoning_effort field with values low, high, or max (default max).
notable: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, so existing SDKs can be reused
Kimi K3.1 Pro has a 1M-token context window and native visual understanding
High-speed variant advertised at about 2-3x the output speed of K3.1 Pro
Includes a no-code Playground for testing prompts
caveats: Pricing is not stated on this page; the high-speed variant's pricing is on a separate page
Kimi Business for enterprise users is available via contact sales (from listing, not the page text)
